title: On inverse aggregate network assignment games
abstract: arXiv:2611.03409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To design platforms for multi-operator mobility markets coordinating their operations or infrastructure to support them, models are needed to understand the behavior of these operators and travelers in a shared network. Assignment games can prove useful, but operationalizing them requires adopting a more generalized aggregate assignment game framework that allows for identification and estimation. We extend such a framework to aggregate network assignment games, proposing a path-based formulation and a PURC-based formulation along with solution algorithms. An inverse optimization model is proposed for the link-based formulation. It is solved by a quadratic program that separates into a buyer block, which retains the node potentials and imposes every observed zero-flow cell, and a seller block. This estimator, introduced in the literature for uncapacitated route choice, is extended here to a capacitated two-sided market, with rationing

translated_title: 论逆聚合网络分配博弈
translated_abstract: 为设计多运营商出行市场的协调平台或支持其运营的基础设施，需要能够理解运营商与出行者在共享网络中行为的模型。分配博弈可以发挥作用，但要将其付诸应用，需要采用更广义的聚合分配博弈框架以支持识别与估计。本文将该框架扩展至聚合网络分配博弈，提出了基于路径的表述和基于PURC的表述，并给出了相应的求解算法。针对基于链路的表述，本文提出了一个逆优化模型，该模型通过一个二次规划求解，该二次规划分解为买方模块（保留节点位势，并对每个观测到的零流量单元施加约束）和卖方模块。这一估计器在文献中最初用于无容量约束的路径选择，本文将其扩展至带有配给机制的有容量双边市场。
tldr: 本文将聚合分配博弈框架扩展至聚合网络分配博弈，提出了基于路径和PURC的表述及求解算法，并通过分离买方与卖方模块的逆优化二次规划，将估计器从无容量路径选择问题扩展到带配给机制的有容量双边市场。
